_about: E. A. Sonnenschein (1851-1929), Professor of Classics at Mason College, Birmingham, raw IA OCR: his Plautus editions, Captivi with Bentley's notes, new edition (Swan Sonnenschein and Allen, 1880), Mostellaria (Deighton, Bell, 1884), Rudens (Clarendon Press, 1891); and Bentley's Plautine Emendations from his copy of Gronovius (Anecdota Oxoniensia, Clarendon Press, 1883). Latin-dense volumes kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling. Classical scholarship (lane B, round dv). No uids minted.

e-a-sonnenschein-plautus-captivi-1880: T. Macci Plauti Captivi, with an introduction, critical apparatus, explanatory notes and an appendix of Bentley's notes, edited by Edward A. Sonnenschein, new edition (London: W. Swan Sonnenschein and Allen, 1880)
e-a-sonnenschein-bentley-plautine-emenda: Bentley's Plautine Emendations from his copy of Gronovius, by E. A. Sonnenschein, Anecdota Oxoniensia, Classical Series vol. I part IV (Oxford: Clarendon Press, 1883)
e-a-sonnenschein-plautus-mostellaria-188: T. Macci Plauti Mostellaria, with notes critical and exegetical and an introduction by E. A. Sonnenschein (Cambridge: Deighton, Bell; London: George Bell, 1884)
e-a-sonnenschein-plautus-rudens-1891: T. Macci Plauti Rudens, edited with critical and explanatory notes by Edward A. Sonnenschein (Oxford: Clarendon Press, 1891)

e-a-sonnenschein-plautus-captivi-1880.author: title page OCRs the editor as 'EDWAED A. SONNENSCHEIN, M.A. Late Scholar of University College, Oxford' (London: W. Swan Sonnenschein and Allen, 1880)
